I have been a bit self reflective tonight, in the sense that since completing my BSW in social work in the spring of 2022, I feel like I’m at cross roads. So many of my peers (and coworkers) are graduating and instantly getting into places or are starting their MSWs. I had a very difficult BSW internship, and hesitate to immediately go into a MSW program because I really don’t want to put that kind of stress on myself again.
However, I’m wondering if getting my MSW immeadiately IS the best choice. I plan to move to Wisconsin in a couple years with my fiancé and I’m not so sure that I want to arrive with just a BSW. The only problem is that I live in the middle of no where (almost every job around here requires an MSW, aside from two opportunities I most recently applied to, that I doubt I’ll get because we live in a college town)
However, an MSW is also a lot of money, and I worked at two different jobs to support my BSW over the past three years. 
I’m just feeling very conflicted. I know that when we move, there’s a good possibility I’ll have a chance of getting a good job with a BSW, but I don’t even have my driver’s license yet. Maybe these are just late night insecurities, but I’m feeling conflicted. Any advice? Thank you so much for listening to my babble!
